import pandas as pd

# Extract numeric crowd values from the formatted strings
df['crowd_numeric'] = df['crowd'].astype(int)

# Find the maximum crowd value
max_crowd = df['crowd_numeric'].max()

# Check if the Collingwood vs Melbourne game has the maximum crowd
collingwood_melbourne_crowd = df.loc[
    ((df['home team'] == 'collingwood') & (df['away team'] == 'melbourne')) |
    ((df['home team'] == 'melbourne') & (df['away team'] == 'collingwood')),
    'crowd_numeric'
].values[0]

answer = collingwood_melbourne_crowd == max_crowd
